description: Keep a preview permanently: claims a site made with publish_website into the user's GearHost account, so it becomes a permanent CloudSite at the same URL (no 72h expiry). Each account gets ONE free CloudSite. If the account already has it, the result has status "free_site_used" and names that site: tell the user, and offer the two ways forward it gives (put the content on the free site with publish_to_my_site, or keep this one on a paid plan). Only after the user agrees to a plan's price, call again with plan and accept_charges:true. Use when the user wants to keep their site. Requires signing in to GearHost: if they aren't signed in, they are asked to sign in or create a free account. Needs the preview's manage token (from publish_website). Returns structuredContent { status, url, claimed, expires_at, dashboard_url }.

accept_charges.description: true only after the user agreed to the plan's monthly price.

plan.description: Only when the account's free CloudSite is already used: the paid plan to keep this site on (a name from the free_site_used result, e.g. "Starter").

token.description: The manage token of the preview to claim (keep it forever).

name: claim_website

setup.description: in_progress while the CloudSite is set up in the background (~2 min; the site keeps serving), then done.

title: Claim website to my account
